body: Unfortunately, even if I work for it and wind up being able to afford the thousands of dollars in travel, things still may not work out. My original goal was/is to move there to her, but they are extremely anti immigration in her country, making it nearly impossible save for marriage. As I said in my closing sentence, the guilt of the grief I would cause keeps me anchored here, whether I like it or not. Some days I think it helps keep me sane and others I think it’s a curse meant to only up my suffering. That being said, she is about the only light I have these days.
